column3: Parallel use of لَبِثْتَ and عُمُر as an argumentative account of a known life among a people.
Locates the Qur'an as received from beyond the speaker, a parallel source claim.
The closing أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ supplies a parallel appeal to reasoning, though its idol polemic is distinct.
Shared speech and أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ, but the scene concerns concealed communal argument.
Same-surah reception of revelation by a man and hostile labeling provide a nearby parallel.
V12 keeps age and reversal as a parallel, but not the speaker's prior life as evidence.

Identifies the text as تَنزِيلٌ from al-Rahman al-Rahim, a general source parallel.
The challenge to produce a surah supplies a secondary boundary around the claim that the recited text is not self-produced.
نزله على قلبك links the Qur'an to mediated descent, a source parallel.
News of the unseen disclosed by الوحي and the speaker's non-presence offer a close evidentiary parallel.
The counterfactual مِنْ عِندِ غَيْرِ ٱللَّهِ supplies a direct source-testing parallel.
أنزل الله عليك الكتاب والحكمة gives a general descent-and-teaching frame.
أوحينا إليك as with earlier messengers supplies a prophetic-continuity parallel.
بلغ ما أنزل إليك clarifies the messenger's task as delivery of what was sent.
ما على الرسول إلا البلاغ limits the messenger's role in a way relevant to the public address.
وأوحي إلي هذا القرآن directly names the Qur'an as revelation used for warning.
اتبع ما أوحي إليك closely parallels 10:16's non-autonomous recitation.
كتاب أنزل إليك and the warning function provide a source-and-address parallel.
اتبعوا ما أنزل إليكم supplies a secondary following-the-sent-text parallel.
The unlettered messenger and what is written of him add a secondary biographical boundary.
إن أتبع إلا ما يوحى إلي parallels the focus's denial of independent production.
كلام الله heard by an addressee provides a public-recitation reception parallel.
آيات الكتاب الحكيم adds the immediate same-surah textual frame.
ما كان هذا القرآن أن يفترى ... ولكن تصديق directly addresses the non-fabrication claim.
أم يقولون افتراه and the surah challenge form the immediate contrary accusation and reply.
بل كذبوا بما لم يحيطوا بعلمه adds a nearby reception boundary, not a source proof.
واتبع ما يوحى إليك directly continues the same-surah account of prophetic following.
أم يقولون افتراه with the surah challenge parallels the accusation-and-response pattern.
كتاب موسى and شاهد منه provide a secondary witness-and-revelation frame.
ما كنت تعلمها أنت ولا قومك من قبل gives a close prior-public-knowledge parallel.
نوحي إليك ... وإن كنت من قبله لمن الغافلين closely parallels newly disclosed content after a prior lifetime.
وما كنت لديهم ... إذ أجمعوا gives a direct non-presence proof for revealed historical knowledge.
أنزلناه حكما عربيا supplies a descent and Arabic-address parallel.
بلسان قومه places a messenger's message within the audience's language and public intelligibility.
إنا نحن نزلنا الذكر supplies a direct descent frame, though not the biographical argument.
وما أنزلنا عليك الكتاب إلا لتبين gives a transmission-and-clarification parallel.
The collective challenge to bring the like of this Qur'an supplies a secondary non-human-source boundary.
بالحق أنزلناه وبالحق نزل frames descent and the messenger's announcing role.
لتقرأه على الناس ... ونزلناه تنزيلا gives a close public-recitation and staged-descent parallel.
اتل ما أوحي إليك directly joins recitation to what has been revealed.
كذلك نقص عليك من أنباء ما قد سبق and آتيناك ... ذكرا provide a close historical-disclosure parallel.

إنما أنذركم بالوحي directly restricts warning to revelation.

وما كنت بجانب الطور ... ولكنا رحمة من ربك supplies another direct non-presence and sending parallel.
اتل ما أوحي إليك من الكتاب directly joins the imperative to recite with revealed text.

تنزيل الكتاب لا ريب فيه من رب العالمين gives a general source parallel.
تنزيل العزيز الرحيم directly identifies descent from a divine source.
إن هو إلا ذكر وقرآن مبين supplies a secondary denial of poetic authorship.
إنا أنزلنا عليك الكتاب للناس بالحق links descent, public address, and truth.
إنما أنا بشر مثلكم يوحى إلي sharply combines ordinary human biography with revelation.
ما كنت تدري ما الكتاب ولا الإيمان but جعلناه نورا ... نوحي supplies a close before-and-after knowledge boundary.

تنزيل من رب العالمين directly identifies the Qur'an's descent and source.
رسولا يتلو عليكم آيات الله gives a public-recitation parallel.

لأخذنا منه باليمين continues the anti-fabrication boundary.
ثم لقطعنا منه الوتين continues the anti-fabrication boundary.

ثم إن علينا بيانه adds a direct clarification route alongside recitation.

وما هو بقول شيطان رجيم supplies a direct contrary source boundary.
سنقرئك فلا تنسى directly makes the speaker's recitation received and sustained.
